selection: The 18 operational source-bank network definitions contain no stable right-turn g. Propose a separate Hangzhou development package to align the short first CityFlow stage using the established Jinan convention.

first_readout.budget: 15 fixed pairs from 12 states, 7 target seeds and 24 distinct existing branches. Zero new simulations and zero fits.
first_readout.primary: For each paired phase request compute high minus low for the true number of stop-line entries in 10 seconds, separately for the fixed right-turn movement and its named straight counterpart. High and low refer to nominal straight G exposure of 4 and 0 seconds while right g is unchanged.
first_readout.execution: For both requests extract the two movements' actual signal timelines from saved frames, using frame[t+1].applied_states for the executed interval t. Report every planned pair, the actual exposure contrast, clearance differences, ties and missing measurements. Never replace a pair.
first_readout.summary: Show the paired counts and changes. Average movements within each state, then states within each seed and seeds equally. List joint observations where the right discharges less and the straight more in the high arm, and those with the reverse pattern. Other phase signals can also change. The paired estimate concerns the two complete actions.
first_readout.decision: Proceed to the separate source measurement pilot only if the planned exposure difference is executed with matching actual right signals and more straight / fewer right entries occurs on at least two different seeds. Report the contrary observations as well. This minimal repeatability condition budgets a pilot only. Otherwise close this ten-second readout without changing the pairs or horizon.

conditional_source_pilot.budget: Two fixed source seeds, 31061101 and 31061102, original Hangzhou demand. At most four 3600-second trajectories (native program and PhasePressure per seed), zero alternative-action branches and zero fits.
conditional_source_pilot.build: Use a new server directory and SUMO 1.22.0. Derive the stable signal program from the original Hangzhou CityFlow road links and the same short-stage permissive interpretation as Jinan v9. Bind the original Hangzhou SUMO route and vehicle file. Compare final physical movement/phase identities, lane geometry, timings and directed junction priority with the original and target. Use netconvert and inspect the resulting same-lane priority relations; editing signal case alone is insufficient.
conditional_source_pilot.physical_admission: Require eight stable actions per TLS, the original 2983 scheduled route/departure pairs and physically mapped right-g / straight-G merges with dedicated incoming lanes and switchable straight priority. Document which merges have the necessary directed rule. Resolve any discrepancy that prevents interpreting the proposed source before native execution.
conditional_source_pilot.measurement: Track collisions and teleports throughout each run. In the PP trajectories examine all 16 TLS at fixed anchors 600 and 1800 seconds (64 scheduled TLS states in all). Use the first eight-action-eligible 10-second epoch through anchor+60 per TLS, recording missing epochs. At each epoch count distinct near vehicles on each inlet, exact g/G physical links, and nominal action pairs that keep right service fixed and change straight priority. Report by whole seed against the existing Jinan support, including the stronger priority-flow conditions.
conditional_source_pilot.decision: Any collision or teleport holds the package. Missing or one-seed-only joint supply holds the proposed source. Repeated observed joint supply permits planning a separate response collection after judging overlap with Jinan. The four trajectories establish development feasibility only.
